### A Willingness to Go with God
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/a-willingness-to-go-with-god
Passage: Genesis 12:1-2
Points:
- God's call leaves little room for negotiation and can set life on a completely new trajectory.
- Human nature naturally clings to safety and comfort, resisting major changes in location or lifestyle.
- Believers who face resistance from family should pray for them rather than trying to force agreement.
- When you are willing to walk with God, He guides your steps and turns your life into a blessing for others.

### When God Says “Go”
Author: Charles F. Stanley
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/when-god-says-go-2
Passage: Genesis 12:1-4
Points:
- The divine summons to Abram was an urgent command to move, not an optional request or suggestion.
- Abram was called to leave everything familiar behind and follow God into the unknown without a map.
- The Lord promised to show the destination and direct the steps along the way.
- Unlike people who seek loopholes or hesitate, Abram demonstrated faith through prompt, total obedience.
- The only righteous response to God's instruction is wholehearted submission to His will.
